name: RIDGERUNNERS
description:
About This Game

TIME TO MOVE FAST

Ski down mountains, launch across valleys, and carry your speed from one slope to the next.

RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer set across huge procedural landscapes. Find your own way between checkpoints, take on mountain missions, and learn to link your movements into one continuous run. Explore solo, race against other players times, or chase a ghost to discover where you can gain those last few seconds.

MASTER YOUR MOMENTUM

Turn the terrain into speed. Build momentum on a descent, launch from a crest, and steer towards a slope that keeps you moving.

Your runner determines the tools you bring:

  • Three distinct runners: Flow’s charged jumps and agile control, or Rook’s jetpack and movement weapons, and a third yet to be announced.

  • Hazards that keep you moving: evade turrets, outrun hunter drones, and dodge lasers as you find your way across varied and dangerous terrain.

  • Mountain missions: race checkpoint courses, steal a defended relic, escape an advancing avalanche and more.

  • Open routes: checkpoints set your destination; you choose how to reach them.

  • Free Ski: explore the mountain at your own pace and discover more routes.

  • Solo and async online with live presence: chase personal bests, race ghosts or alongside others.

  • Medals, global leaderboards, and replays: set a target, study a faster run, and try a new line.

THE MAP IS YOUR PLAYGROUND.

The routes tell you where, they don’t tell you how.

Follow a valley, carve across a mountainside, or launch over the ridge. Experiment with different approaches between checkpoints and discover which lines work best.

Progress through missions to put your movement to the test, or head into Free Ski to relax and explore in peace until you feel ready for your next challenge.

KEEP MOVING. STAY ALIVE.

You’re choosing a route under fire. Turrets track your approach, hunter drones give chase, and orbital strikes threaten your path.

Change direction, adjust your height, and find a way through without throwing away your speed. A direct line can save seconds but only if you make it to the other side.

THE FASTER YOU GO, THE FURTHER YOU FLY.

The next landing is the start of your next burst of speed.

Catch a downhill slope, steer around an obstacle, and carry your momentum into the next jump. Use your tools to control your height and keep the run flowing.

Then go again. Beat your ghost, try a rival’s route, or find a faster line of your own.
short_desc: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Build speed downhill and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.
